import thinkthen as tt

# the outage first, then the quote due today, then the
# bill due in a month, and the newsletter last
inbox = ["Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here. No reply needed.",
    "Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay",
    "Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days",
    "Please send the signed quote by 5 pm today"]
for one in tt.rank("Is this urgent?", inbox):
    print(one["record"])
